notes.title: V1.15 Update
notes.notes: The new legendary turret "Commander" requires 19,999 Space Coins.

notes.title: V1.14 Update
notes.notes:
1. Optimized some UI displays.

2. In the Free Mode main interface, players can now view the upgraded turret attributes.

3. Strengthened the effects of certain turrets after upgrading.

notes.title: V1.13 Update
notes.notes: A new auto-upgrade option has been added, which can be checked in the settings menu. It is recommended for use in Free Mode.

notes.title: V1.12 Update
notes.notes:
1. Five new buttons have been added to the Free Mode for saving formations, located on the left side of the interface.

2. A new legendary turret, "99K," has been added, which can be purchased for 99,000 Space Coins in Free Mode.

notes.title: V1.11 Update
notes.notes: Optimized the UI display of health bars and damage numbers.

notes.title: Bug fixes and adjustments.
notes.notes:
1. Reduce the difficulty of Level 3 and Level 4.

2. Fix UI display errors at 720P resolution.

3. Fix UI display errors in certain languages.

notes.title: The Full of " Space Cycle" Release is Here!
notes.notes:
1.Experience More Levels and Defenses!
Building on the foundation of the demo, the full release offers new levels and defense units for a richer, more exciting gameplay experience.

2.Epic Units Join the Battle!
Unlock Epic Units during special supply rounds. These units come with unique mechanics and powerful abilities to help you craft smarter strategies.

3.Double Speed Mode is Now Available!
Enjoy faster-paced gameplay and dive into quick, thrilling sessions.

4.We Value Your Feedback!
Feel free to share your thoughts in the review and discussion sections. We’ll respond promptly and work actively to improve the game experience.

5.Thank You for Your Support!
Developing this game has been a challenging but rewarding journey. Your encouragement keeps us going. Please share the game with others and help us grow the community!
